pages.title: Ice Eel
pages.text: $(thing)Ice Eel$(): A long dark eel with lights down its sides, hunting grazers, and biting whoever comes too close. Three meals and it spawns another; a day with none and it starves. The predator of Titan's hidden ocean. Found in Titan's hidden ocean.$(br2)$(thing)Drops$(): Eel Photophore, Vent Biofilm.
